title: scene mode · a drawn bed · 1

techniques.name: Garden as drawing

weight.label: Line weight
weight.note: Every stroke of the figure at this multiple of its measured width.

hand.label: Hand
hand.note: How far a line may wander from its ruled path, in figure units. 0 is ruled; higher redraws every line, box and pole by hand.

corner.label: Box corners
corner.note: Corner radius of every box, in figure units. A box drawn round in the source keeps at least its own.

arrow.label: Arrowheads
arrow.note: Size of the arrowheads on directed lines, as a multiple of a head 7 strokes long.

hatch.label: Tone as hatching
hatch.note: 0 fills every toned shape solid; 1 lays the same tone as hatching; between, both.

gap.label: Hatch spacing
gap.note: Distance between hatch lines, in figure units.

type.label: Type size
type.note: Every label at this multiple of its measured size, from its own anchor.

seed.label: Seed
seed.note: Re-rolls the hand: where each line wanders.

techniques.implementation: The garden drawn as a bed, a plan, an ink drawing and a sheet. The geometry is measured from the source figure; the engine redraws it with weight, hand, corners, arrowheads, hatched tone and type size as dials.

techniques.name: Measured inks
techniques.implementation: solid ink pixels of each figure, read at full resolution, are clustered to five colors; a color is kept when it holds at least 4% of the ink.

techniques.name: Figure and ground
techniques.implementation: The ground is the most common border color of a figure; ink is every pixel more than 40 levels from it.

pass_order: line · every stroke, ruled or by hand
